turns.speaker: Steve
turns.text: You're interested in how our thoughts and ideas shift throughout the day.  That's a great area of study, actually - it's related to cognitive flexibility and the concept of "mental set." Essentially, our brains tend to stick with what we've already learned or experienced, and it can take effort to switch to a new way of thinking. The more we're exposed to opposing ideas, the more our mental set can shift. Have you looked into the work of Mihaly Csikszentmihalyi on this topic?
